dishes.name: Matouille
dishes.desc: Tome des Bauges baked with white wine, garlic and nutmeg until it melts into a creamy spread, served with potatoes, salad or bread. A mountain-farm dish of the Bauges.

dishes.name: Chambéry chocolate truffle
dishes.desc: Hand-rolled ganache of cream, butter and chocolate coated in cocoa. Said to have been born in Chambéry in the late 19th century.

dishes.name: Gâteau de Savoie
dishes.desc: Light sponge of eggs, sugar and flour, eaten plain, with icing sugar or jam. Tradition places its origin at the court of the Counts of Savoy in Chambéry.

dishes.name: Diots and crozets
dishes.desc: Pork sausages simmered in white wine and onions, served with crozets, tiny square Savoyard pasta. A winter staple across Savoie.

dishes.name: Bauges cake
dishes.desc: Cake of whey, butter, local honey and fruit, with blackcurrant jam and a groove of quince jelly. Made in the Bauges massif above Chambéry.
